newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on late short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on late short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Monday, lifted by short-covering ahead of the close after prices drifted within narrow ranges for most of the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen to 1.3 yen per kg firmer. Most-active benchmark June was up 0.8 yen at 145.8 yen.
Activity was mainly spurred by technical factors as the market received little direction from the currency market.
"Trade was directionless. The benchmark June could hover around 145 yen for some time," one trader said.
